Facts: A company (华清水泥公司) was set up by natural persons. They engaged in fraudulent applications for central fiscal subsidies, falsifying data, using false contracts, etc. Also there is transfer of assets, but main crime is fraud of state funds, i.e., "行贿"? No, they obtained funds by false statements, i.e., "诈骗" of state? The appropriate charge is "诈骗" or "合同诈骗"? They used false contracts? Also there is "单位行贿"? They gave cash to officials? They got cash from demolition compensation, but not bribery. They received instructions from officials (熊某) who signed. They may have bribed officials? Not described as giving money to officials for favor. They got funds from government after false application. That's fraud.

Also there is "非法占用" no. "挪用" maybe? They transferred funds to personal accounts. That's embezzlement? They obtained funds from government and then transferred to personal accounts. That could be "挪用资金" (embezzlement of public funds). But typical charge: "诈骗" (fraud) of state funds. Also "伪造公司印章" not.

The rule: If false contract used to obtain money/property, classify as "合同诈骗". Here they used false equipment supply contract to claim equipment existed, to get subsidy. That's a contract (equipment supply contract) used deceitfully to obtain state funds. So "合同诈骗" is appropriate.

Also there is "单位行贿"? They didn't bribe, they got funds. So not.

Thus single crime: 合同诈骗.

Thus answer: [罪名]合同诈骗<eoa>
